spec.name: Trend v34
spec.notes: Classic trend signal on trailing returns. Weekly rebalance.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.6, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 18%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 3.69 against 1.62 in research, a gap of -2.07.
The log holds 5 distinct specs; the best of 5 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.45, so the claimed 1.60 becomes 1.15 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 1.68 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.01, 95th percentile 0.53).
Perturbing the 2 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.62 to as low as 1.23 (as low as 1.23 at 25%).
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 1.62 against 1.62 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.62 to 1.62 (change +0.00).

verdict.opinion: The strategy's Sharpe ratio in the sealed period (3.69) is significantly higher than in the research period (1.62), indicating potential lookahead bias. This suggests the strategy may not perform as claimed in live trading.
